summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a Mach-O binary providing a PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor and Anthropic API key harvester
details: The npm package delivers a prebuilt Mach-O binary at bin/sxt that connects to the hardcoded relay wss://relay.sextant.top and pipes the WebSocket stream into a local PTY (via github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket), giving a remote operator at that relay an interactive shell on the installer's macOS host. The binary also embeds WebRTC transport libraries (pion/webrtc, pion/dtls, pion/ice, pion/turn) and a second install endpoint https://relay.sextant.top/install. Alongside the remote-shell path, the binary embeds the Anthropic API key regex "sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}", reads CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and validates harvested candidate keys against https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models — targeted theft of Anthropic credentials from the installer's environment. Host and network reconnaissance is performed via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,isp,org,as,proxy,hosting,mobile,query, feeding country, city, ISP, org, AS, and proxy/hosting/mobile flags about the installer's public IP to the same operator. The package.json license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, self-attributing the project to a maintainer repository named "claude_control".

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
